items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: they elected a colored Lieutenant, Lieutenant Chaney (PHONETIC). So they put him over the company.

ctx.x: Yeah. Part of the company that -- yeah.

But little by little I began to form little groups and they began to sing and then played in the church, and finally they made a company, the 13th Special Service, and I was head of the music department. And they elected a colored Lieutenant, Lieutenant Chaney (PHONETIC). So they put him over the company. So we formed the 13th Special Service right there.
